description_en: Queries the list of uninstall applications under the current Alibaba Cloud account in batches
description_zh: 批量查询当前阿里云账号下卸载申请列表
name: ListUninstallApplications

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The collection of uninstall application IDs
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: The collection of uninstall application statuses
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.help_en: The username. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）、星号（*）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The department to which the user belongs. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 用户所属部门。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（_）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格
parameters.name: department

parameters.help_en: The MAC address of the terminal device
parameters.name: mac

parameters.help_en: The name of the terminal device. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. Entering only an underscore () additionally queries all terminal devices whose names contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters
parameters.help_zh: 终端设备名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）、短划线（-）、下划线（\）、分隔号（/）、at（@）和空格。单独输入下划线（\）将额外查询所有名称中带4字节utf-8字符的终端设备
parameters.name: hostname

Windows_Wuying：无影云桌面系统

FullDepartment.description_en: The list of full department paths

Hostname.description_en: The name of the terminal device

IdpName.description_en: The name of the user identity source

IsUninstall.description_en: Indicates whether the uninstallation has been performed

Mac.description_en: The MAC address of the terminal device

The uninstall application status. Valid values:
Pending: Pending processing.
Approved: Approved.
Rejected: Rejected

卸载申请状态。取值：
Pending：待处理。
Approved：通过。
Rejected：拒绝

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of uninstall applications
